# CLI reference

Place root options before the command and command options after it.
Required values can come from any source listed for the option.
A dash means there is no binding or default in that column.
See [configuration precedence](order-of-precedence.md) for resolution rules.

## `sbom`

| Option | Environment | Config key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--env-file` | — | — | — | Load a trusted dotenv file explicitly (before the subcommand) |
| `-V`, `--version` | — | — | — | Show the SBOM CLI version and exit |

## `sbom upload`

| Option | Environment | Config key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | `help` | — | show this help message and exit |
| `-u`, `--api-url` | `SBOM_API_URL` | `api-url` | Required | API base URL for service |
| `-k`, `--api-key` | `SBOM_API_KEY` | `api-key` | Required | API key for authenticating with the server |
| `--verify-ssl`, `--no-verify-ssl` | `SBOM_VERIFY_SSL` | `verify-ssl` | `true` | Verify SSL certificates (default: true) |
| `-f`, `--file` | — | `file` | Required | Path to the SBOM file to upload |
| `--project-uuid` | `SBOM_PROJECT_UUID` | `project-uuid` | — | Accepted by the parser only. Select the upload target by project name and version. |
| `--project-name` | `SBOM_PROJECT_NAME` | `project-name` | — | Target project name (required with --auto-create) |
| `--project-version` | `SBOM_PROJECT_VERSION` | `project-version` | — | Target project version (required with --auto-create) |
| `--project-tags` | — | `project-tags` | — | Comma-separated project tags |
| `--parent-name` | `SBOM_PARENT_NAME` | `parent-name` | — | Parent project name |
| `--parent-version` | — | `parent-version` | — | Parent project version |
| `--parent-uuid` | `SBOM_PARENT_UUID` | `parent-uuid` | — | Parent project UUID (optional) |
| `--is-latest` | `SBOM_IS_LATEST` | `is-latest` | `false` | Mark this SBOM as the latest version |
| `--auto-create` | `SBOM_AUTO_CREATE` | `auto-create` | `false` | Create the project if it does not already exist (default: false) |

## `sbom delete`

| Option | Environment | Config key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | `help` | — | show this help message and exit |
| `-u`, `--api-url` | `SBOM_API_URL` | `api-url` | Required | API base URL for service |
| `-k`, `--api-key` | `SBOM_API_KEY` | `api-key` | Required | API key for authenticating with the server |
| `--verify-ssl`, `--no-verify-ssl` | `SBOM_VERIFY_SSL` | `verify-ssl` | `true` | Verify SSL certificates (default: true) |
| `--project-uuid` | `SBOM_PROJECT_UUID` | `project-uuid` | — | Project UUID to delete |
| `--project-name` | `SBOM_PROJECT_NAME` | `project-name` | — | Project name to delete |
| `--project-version` | `SBOM_PROJECT_VERSION` | `project-version` | — | Project version to delete (required when using name) |
